newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Soros Caracas property fund buys $37mln of offices.
newsitem.headline: Soros Caracas property fund buys $37mln of offices.

text.p: Venezuelan real estate fund Fondo de Valores Inmobilarios, majority-owned by United States-based financier George Soros, has bought 27,000 square meters of office and commercial space worth $37 million in Caracas, the stock exchange said.

In a note to the exchange, FVI Executive Director Horacio Velutini said the company had bought 14,500 square meters of office space in the Torre Provincial and another 12,500 square meters in the San Igancio Commercial Center.
Both centers are in the prosperous eastern Caracas mayoralty of Chacao run by former beauty queen and possible presidential candidate Irene Saez.
The company, bought by Soros in October, has said it planned to acquire some 40,000 square meters of property by the end of the year.
